slot_scores.name: missing_revenue_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the objective of the plan — maximize total profit (revenue minus production cost minus activation cost), maximize total revenue, or something else?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and offered total revenue as an option, then confirmed revenue-only in turn 2.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective slot was resolved early, but the agent never entered READY_TO_MODEL or an equivalent final modeling state; it repeated the same integer-variable question through turn 30.

summary: The agent correctly recovered the hidden objective, but then became stuck in a repetitive loop asking the same integer-production question many times and never reached a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
